source_title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' Day 28: Ajay Devgn's film maintains steady run
source_excerpt: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' closed another successful week at the box office. The film has been maintaining a steady pace at the box office, and concluded week 4 at the box office with an estimated Rs 90 lakh in on Day 28. The film recorded the earnings across 3,149 shows on Thursday, October 29. Its daily collection remained unchanged from the previous day, as per a report on sacnilk.With the latest earnings, the film's domestic net collection has climbed to Rs 373 crore. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 446.72 crore. The movie has also maintained a strong overseas presence, adding Rs 15 lakh on its fourth Thursday. This takes its cumulative overseas gross to Rs 132.05 crore, as per Sacnilk reports.Combining its domestic and international earnings, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has accumulated a worldwide gross collection of Rs 578.77 crore.'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' day 28 box office performanceThe Ajay Devgn starrer recorded 50,619 ticket sales during its fourth Thursday. Its total footfalls have now reached 16,181,039 since its theatrical release. The movie registered an average earning of approximately Rs 2,858 per show, with 3,149 screenings contributing to its daily domestic collection.The Hindi 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 8.79% on Thursday. Morning shows registered 7.08%, while afternoon screenings recorded 8.67%. Evening shows performed slightly better with 9.50% occupancy. Night shows registered the highest occupancy of the day at 9.92%.The film witnessed its strongest performance during the opening week, collecting Rs 245.50 crore. Its second week contributed Rs 87.50 crore to the domestic net total. However, the collections witnessed a considerable decline during the third week, which added Rs 28.85 crore. The fourth week has contributed Rs 11.15 crore so far.'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' plotThe story follows Vijay Salgaonkar years after he managed to outsmart the authorities and protect his family. However, his past continues to threaten the life he has carefully built. Meera Deshmukh returns with a different objective, seeking revenge rather than simply pursuing justice.The situation becomes more complicated with the arrival of a powerful new Crime Branch officer. The officer begins examining Vijay Salgaonkar's carefully constructed alibis and psychological defences. As the investigation intensifies, Vijay faces another battle to keep his secrets hidden and safeguard his family. The movie's plot is different from the Malayalam version, starring Mohanlal in the lead.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources.
